title: Someone is running late
note: A starter plan (illustrative). Copy it, then change any of it to fit your day.

partner.title: One of us is running late
checklist: Tell the officiant and the planner how late

notify.message: One of us is running late; we will start as soon as they arrive.

branches.label: More than that, or no answer

officiant-short.title: Wait for the officiant
checklist: Ask the DJ to play another set

notify.message: The ceremony starts later; please keep playing.

officiant-long.title: Find another officiant
checklist: Call the back-up officiant on your list
Tell the wedding party the start time is moving

notify.message: Our ceremony start is moving later.

guests.title: Guests are delayed by traffic
checklist: Wait up to fifteen minutes before the processional
Ask the ushers to seat late arrivals at the back

notify.message: Guests are delayed by traffic; the ceremony may start a little late.
